signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your office's owner for a new link.

choosePassword.greeting: Hi {{name}}. You will sign in as {{email}}.
choosePassword.invalidBody: Password links work once and expire. Ask your office's owner for a new one.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyBody: Create the first project to get started.
projects.needsDrive: To create projects, connect the office's Google Drive.

newProject.title: New project
newProject.name: Project name
newProject.clientHint: As shown on the client's page. Up to 48 characters.
newProject.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. The page will be {{address}}
newProject.slugTakenBy: This address already belongs to “{{name}}”. Choose another.
newProject.publishNote: The project is published at once: the client can open its link right away. Its folders are created in the office's Google Drive.
newProject.noStagesHint: No stages ticked: you set up the stages later, on the project page.
newProject.nameTakenBy: There's already a project called “{{name}}”. Choose another name.
newProject.stagesHint_one: {{count}} stage ticked. The type's usual stages come ticked; tick or untick as you like.
newProject.stagesHint_other: {{count}} stages ticked. The type's usual stages come ticked; tick or untick as you like.

cover.chooseHint: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 10 MB
cover.unreadable: This photo couldn't be read. Choose another.

projectSettings.recipientsHint: Clients will automatically get updates about the project by email.
projectSettings.title: Project
projectSettings.name: Project name
projectSettings.noCover: Without a cover, the painel shows a sample photo.
projectSettings.linkHint: The page is at {{address}}. The old link keeps working.
projectSettings.publicHint: Whoever gets the link can open the page.
projectSettings.withPasswordHint: The client types it once per device; it lasts 90 days.
projectSettings.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password. A new one asks for it again on every device.
projectSettings.passwordNew: At least 6 characters. Send it to the client with the link.

update.available: A new version of the dashboard is available.

errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.csrf_token_missing_or_wrong: We could not confirm this action. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid_request: We could not send this information. Reload the page and try again.
errors.link_invalid: This link no longer works. Ask your office's owner for a new one.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.owner_only: Only the office's owner can do this.
errors.drive_not_configured: Connecting Google Drive is not available in this environment yet.
errors.drive_denied: The connection was cancelled at Google. Try again whenever you like.
errors.drive_link_invalid: This connection request has expired. Start again with Connect.
errors.drive_connect_failed: Google Drive could not be connected. Please try again shortly.
errors.drive_share_failed: The folder in your Drive could not be prepared. Nothing was changed; try again.
errors.drive_other_account: This Google account cannot reach the office's folder. Reconnect with the account used before; nothing was changed.
errors.drive_not_connected: Connect the office's Google Drive before doing this.
errors.drive_expired: The Google Drive connection expired. Reconnect in Settings → Google Drive.
errors.invalid_office_name: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
errors.invalid_email: Enter a valid email address, like contact@office.com.
errors.logo_wrong_type: Use a PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG image.
errors.logo_too_large: Use an image of up to 5 MB.
errors.drive_unreadable: The portal cannot read the office's Google Drive folder. Check its sharing in Settings → Google Drive.
errors.invalid_project_name: Enter the project's name, up to 120 characters.
errors.invalid_client_name: Enter the client, up to 48 characters.
errors.invalid_slug: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end. Some words are reserved by the portal.
errors.slug_taken: This address is already in use. Choose another.
errors.project_name_taken: A project with this name already exists. Choose another.
errors.project_not_found: This project no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.project_changed: Someone else changed this project while you were editing. Reload the page to see their changes and try again.
errors.invalid_status_change: This project's status couldn't be changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.project_has_no_folder: This project doesn't have a Google Drive folder yet, so it can't take a photo.
errors.cover_wrong_type: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.cover_too_large: Choose an image of up to 10 MB.
errors.project_archived: This project is archived and can't be changed. Restore it first.
errors.unknown_stage: One of the chosen stages no longer exists. Reload the page and try again.
errors.page_not_found: We couldn't find this page. Check the link with the office.
errors.page_locked: This page is protected by a password.
errors.wrong_page_password: Wrong password. Check it with the office.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.password_required: Set a password to protect the page.
errors.file_not_found: This file is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.file_too_large: Send files of up to {{max}} MB.
errors.invalid_file_name: This file needs a name. Rename it and send it again.
errors.upload_failed: The file couldn't be sent. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact support.
errors.hidden_file_name: Files whose names start with _ don't show on the site. Rename the file and send it again.
errors.stage_has_no_folder: This stage has no file folder, so it can't take files.
errors.file_not_ours: This file wasn't sent through the site. To hide it, rename it in the stage's folder starting with _.
errors.file_not_ours_to_move: This file wasn't sent through the site. To move it to another stage, move it into that stage's folder.
errors.invalid_detail: Check the details: each appears once, areas are numbers and dates are dates.
errors.invalid_meeting: Check the meeting: a subject of up to 40 characters, a date ahead, an end after the start, and a link starting with https://.
errors.invalid_stage: This stage couldn't be changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.files_unavailable: The file couldn't be opened just now. Try again in a moment.

drive.intro: Project files live in the office's Google Drive. The portal only reaches files and folders it creates itself.
drive.notConnectedBody: Connecting creates a “Portal Clientes” folder in your Drive. Your files stay yours.
drive.openFolder: Open the folder in Google Drive
drive.expiredBody: Client pages stay up; uploads and new projects wait until you reconnect.
drive.readerProblem: The portal cannot read the folder. Check it was not moved or unshared.
drive.localBody: On this computer, projects use the local example folders.
drive.disconnectConfirm: The portal stops reaching your Drive now. Files stay in the folder.
drive.ownerOnly: Only the office's owner can connect or disconnect.
drive.noticeNone: Connect Google Drive to create projects and upload files from here.
drive.noticeExpired: The Google Drive connection expired. Client pages stay up; uploads and new projects wait until you reconnect.

firstSteps.title: First steps
firstSteps.storage: Connect where project files live (Google Drive)
firstSteps.membersNote: The office's owner needs to complete these steps.
firstSteps.office: Fill in the office's details (contact email and logo)

office.name: Office name
office.nameHint: Shown at the top of client pages and in the browser tab.
office.emailHint: Used as the reply-to address on emails to clients.
office.logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 5 MB.
office.logoNeedsDrive: Connect Google Drive to upload the logo; it is kept in the office's Drive.
office.ownerOnly: Only the office's owner can change these details.

page.noMeeting: No meeting scheduled. The next one will appear here.
page.notFoundBody: Check the link with the office. If the project moved, ask for the new link.
page.lockedBody: This page is protected by a password. Enter the password the office sent you; this device stays unlocked for 90 days.
page.draftNote: Draft, only you can see it
page.linkCopiedDraft: Link copied. The client will see the page once it's published.
page.noFiles: No files in this stage yet.
page.filesUnavailable: The files couldn't be loaded just now. Try again in a moment.

edit.dropNote: They go to the “{{folder}}” folder in your Drive and show to the client. Up to {{max}} MB a file.
edit.fileHidden: “{{name}}” no longer shows to the client. In Drive, it now starts with _.
edit.archivedNoEdit: Archived project: restore it in the painel to edit.
edit.descriptionHint: Each line becomes a paragraph. Start with “- ” for a list.
edit.noDescription: No description. Tell the client in two or three sentences what the project is.
edit.subject: Subject
edit.subjectHint: Up to 40 characters for the meeting's title.
edit.timeZoneHint: In the office's time. The client adds it to their calendar in one click.
edit.notesPlaceholder: Check the plans and send your comments before the meeting.
edit.removeStageConfirm: Remove “{{title}}” from the page? Its folder and files stay in Drive.
edit.stageRemoved: Stage “{{title}}” removed. Its folder stays in Drive.
edit.addStageHint: The stage goes at the end, with a new folder in Drive.
edit.noStagesYet: Add stages to follow the project's progress.
edit.allDoneNote: All stages show as done to the client.
edit.currentNote: Current stage. The client sees “In progress”.

email.subject: News on {{project}}
email.stageAdvanced: The project moved on to the {{stage}} stage.
email.why: You get these emails because {{office}} added your address to the {{project}} project.
email.unsubscribe: I don't want these emails anymore
email.unsubscribeAsk: {{email}} will no longer get news on the {{project}} project by email.
email.unsubscribed: Done. {{email}} will no longer get news on the {{project}} project.
email.unsubscribeInvalid: This link no longer works. If you still get emails you don't want, contact the office.

updates.label: Updates
updates.title: Latest updates
updates.empty: No updates yet. New files, notes and meetings will show here.
updates.advanced: The project moved on to a new stage

files.pdfHint: PDF document. Use “Open original” to see the whole file.
files.otherHint: Open the file to view it in a suitable app.
